title: speq fixture v1
description: One file in the fixtures directory, referenced from a step's bodyFromFixture.ref. Parsed as FixtureFile in speq-cli/src/fixtures/mod.rs.

build.description: The request body this fixture produces. Leaves may be literals or generator blocks, which are resolved at run time. A step's bodyFromFixture.overrides are merged over the result.

schemaRef.description: Schema file the built body is checked against, resolved against the schemas directory. 'speq validate' reports a missing file as a fixture_resolution_error.
